Class com.oroinc.net.DiscardTCPClient 

java.lang.Object
   |
   +----com.oroinc.net.SocketClient
           |
           +----com.oroinc.net.DiscardTCPClient
public class DiscardTCPClient
extends SocketClient
The DiscardTCPClient class is a TCP implementation of a client for the Discard protocol described in RFC 863. To use the class, merely establish a connection with connect and call getOutputStream() to retrieve the discard output stream. Don't close the output stream when you're done writing to it. Rather, call disconnect to clean up properly.

 public static final int DEFAULT_PORT
The default discard port. It is set to 9 according to RFC 863.

 public DiscardTCPClient()
The default DiscardTCPClient constructor. It merely sets the default port to DEFAULT_PORT .

getOutputStream 
 public OutputStream getOutputStream()
Returns an OutputStream through which you may write data to the server. You should NOT close the OutputStream when you're finished reading from it. Rather, you should call disconnect to clean up properly.
